sinopsis.es: Un cortometraje que nace de la exigencia del cuerpo para vincularse por completo con la animación, un trabajo mecánico que lleva a descuidarlo y causa dolor y fatiga. Con acciones repetitivas, sonidos grotescos y técnicas tradicionales, explora cómo el cuerpo en decadencia abandona el papel de creador y se convierte en un operador.
sinopsis.en: A body that hurts is a short film conceived out of a request from the body to be fully involved in the task of animation. The mechanical nature of the work leads to the neglect of the body, causing pain, fatigue, and discomfort. Through repetitive actions, grotesque sound and the use of different hands-on techniques, the video explores the decaying body as an operator rather than a creator, reflecting the lack of attention put into the flesh during labor.
